title: Social skill checks (will/wits, e.g. pressing Prior Halm, confronting Preceptor Aldous, the gray sergeant on the Waiting Bough) can be retried immediately and as many times as needed on failure for only the cost of a turn, with no stated penalty — unlike physical might/grace checks, which usually show an explicit 'fail costs Xhp.' Failure on these is effectively free as long as turns remain.
where: The Ironbound Chapterhouse (Cinderhall), The Waiting Bough (Thornwold), The Priory (Fenmarch)
